title: The workspace editor (code-server) on its own origin
description: App-origin messages for the person's editor: GET /api/v1/editor, POST /auth/editor (the one-time hand-off the editor origin's frame page redeems for an editor-scoped session) and POST /api/v1/editor/open (a conversation file link). The editor origin itself serves code-server; its frame page talks to the app only by postMessage.

offer.description: An agent's offer to show a workspace file, optionally at a line, in the person's editor. It arrives as a notice's editor in a conversation or as an editor.offered event for the account; the person's press opens it through POST /api/v1/editor/open or the browser editor, which check the path again. The path is agent text, shown as data; nothing says the person has seen the offer.

status.description: GET /api/v1/editor (also the result of the empty POST /api/v1/editor/stop): whether this person's daemon offers an editor and whether it runs. Reading never starts it.

handoff.description: POST /auth/editor: a one-minute, single-use token and the editor origin that redeems it.

openRequest.description: POST /api/v1/editor/open: show a workspace-relative file at a line in the running editor. The daemon resolves it inside the workspace and refuses anything outside it.

openResult.description: The editor showed the file. Refusals are errors: file_unavailable (not a file in the workspace) or editor_not_running (no window took it).
